name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 44 – Am 29
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 44. Raises concerns regarding the strengthened protection and enforcement of intellectual property rights, which go beyond the WTO TRIPS Agreement; warns, in particular, that the inclusion of provisions aligned with the 1991 International Convention for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV) may negatively affect farmers’ rights, seed sovereignty and biodiversity; further expresses concern about provisions on supplementary protection for pharmaceutical products in cases of delays in marketing approval, which may extend market exclusivity, delay access to affordable medicines and increase costs for public health systems; calls for a balanced approach to intellectual property that safeguards innovation while protecting public interest objectives;
